source.title: NIST Cybersecurity Framework: Policy Template Guide
source.applicability: Organizations implementing NIST CSF governance; defines documented roles/responsibilities through GV.RR-02 (role assignment), GV.SC-02 (supplier oversight), PR.AT-01/02 (workforce awareness), with concrete policy implementation templates
